teaser: Today, China announced a preliminary anti-dumping duty on imports of canola seed from Canada of 75.8%, which will enter into force on August 14, 2025. Canada is deeply disappointed with China’s decision to implement provisional anti-dumping duties in its self-initiated investigation into imports of canola seed from Canada.
title: Statement by ministers Sidhu and MacDonald on China’s preliminary anti-dumping measures on imports of canola seed from Canada
